title: how to use table charts for dashboard widgets
text:

TABLE OF CONTENTS

 [#Step-1%3A-Add-a-widget] Step 1: Add a widget
 [#Step-2%3A-Choose-Table-chart] Step 2: Choose Table chart
 [#Step-3%3A-Configure-your-widget] Step 3: Configure your widget
 [#Step-3%3A-Save-your-changes] Step 3: Save your changes
Step 1: Add a Widget

Go to your dashboard and Click on the edit icon and then Add widget

Step 2: Choose Table Chart

Scroll down to the widget you want to add and change the chart type to table

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155022885087/original/Tv-DNpkI8qeG5vXbj_anl0A3YGPmNnTQKg.png?1710421262] 

Step 3: Configure Your Widget

Click on Select Columns to manage columns you want on your widget

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155022885097/original/EyMRUGmsd3nGgTZ5OvmnuAA5nQVsch5a9w.png?1710421277] 

In Advance Settings, you can choose the column on which you want to order the table

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155022885142/original/8rZzu6fO66Tq1o4iEUxrllJh7L3--ovZlQ.png?1710421311] 

Note (Email Widgets): Source Action Name

In Email Widget table charts, Source Action Name helps you identify what triggered the email.
If the email is associated with a workflow, Source Action Name displays the workflow step name to improve traceability in dashboards and reports.

Step 4: Save Your Changes

Click on Save to add your widget on the Dashboard

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155022886687/original/cRu3tWKj6h2y424JHndURAxemS2w7hd57Q.png?1710422439]
